dialogues.speaker: Goldoni
dialogues.text: Watch your tone, citizen. Even I do not have the right to address that exalted Dominus solely by his name.

dialogues.speaker: Goldoni
dialogues.text: Dominus Boethius is a Harmost, exalted to that post by the Sebastos himself, and is the foremost genius in our empire's history. Even Dominus Cassiodor cannot...

dialogues.speaker: Goldoni
dialogues.text: ...No, forget what I said before. I did not mean to be partisan about our Harmosts.

dialogues.speaker: Goldoni
dialogues.text: Regardless, even amongst the empire's outstanding subjects, Dominus Boethius stands tall as the most representative of its spirit.

dialogues.speaker: Goldoni
dialogues.text: His loyalty and passion are undoubtedly worthy of our imitation and respect.
